title: Pass on your grandmother's letter

scenario.en: Your grandmother wrote in English about the past. Your younger brother wants to know what she said.
scenario.ar: جدتك كتبت بالإنجليزي عن الماضي. أخوك الصغير عايز يعرف قالت إيه.

source: "We used to wake up before the sun, and my mother would bake bread every morning. We didn't use to have a fridge, so we bought food on the same day. The neighbours would sit outside together. We used to walk four kilometres to school, and in winter that walk was hard."

task.en: Relay the main points of the letter to your brother.
task.ar: انقل النقط الأساسية في الرسالة لأخوك.

key_points.en: They used to wake up before the sun.
They didn't have a fridge, so they bought food daily.
key_points.ar: مكانش عندهم تلاجة، فكانوا يشتروا الأكل كل يوم.

key_points.en: The neighbours would sit outside together.
key_points.ar: الجيران كانوا يقعدوا برة مع بعض.

key_points.en: They walked four kilometres to school, which was hard in winter.
key_points.ar: كانوا يمشوا ٤ كيلو للمدرسة، وكان صعب في الشتا.

model_answer.en: She says they used to wake up before the sun, and they didn't have a fridge, so they bought food on the same day. The neighbours would sit outside together, and they walked four kilometres to school, which was hard in winter.
model_answer.ar: بتقول إنهم كانوا يصحوا قبل الشمس، ومكانش عندهم تلاجة فكانوا يشتروا الأكل كل يوم. والجيران كانوا يقعدوا برة مع بعض، وكانوا يمشوا ٤ كيلو للمدرسة، وده كان صعب في الشتا.
